name: @adaptive-ds/codeline
description: A planned local-first AI coding workspace built with Solid, Hono, TanStack AI, and Zero.

scripts.build: rm -rf ./dist && bun tsc -p ./tsconfig.json && vite build && bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist/server --target bun --sourcemap=external
scripts.format: biome format --write src test index.html vite.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json biome.json bunfig.toml
scripts.format:check: biome format src test index.html vite.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json biome.json bunfig.toml
